title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Joshua 9: the trick of the Gibeonites, the covenant Israel made, and the oath it kept.

questions.text: Who resorted to a ruse after hearing what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai?
questions.explanation: When the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai, they resorted to a ruse.

questions.text: What was the bread of their food supply like?
questions.explanation: The Gibeonites wore old garments and sandals, and all the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

questions.text: Where did they go to meet Joshua?
questions.explanation: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal.

questions.text: What did they claim when they came to Joshua?
questions.explanation: They told Joshua and the men of Israel that they had come from a far country and asked for a covenant.

answers.text: That they had come from a far country
That they were fleeing from Ai

questions.text: Which two kings did they say they had heard about besides what Yahweh did in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Besides what Yahweh did in Egypt, they mentioned what he did to Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan.

answers.text: Jabin king of Hazor and Jobab king of Madon
Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem and Hoham king of Hebron
Sihon king of Heshbon and Og king of Bashan
The kings of Moab and of Edom

questions.text: What did the men of Israel fail to do before making the covenant?
questions.explanation: The men sampled their provisions and did not ask counsel from Yahweh's mouth.

questions.text: How long after making the covenant did Israel hear that these people were their neighbors?
questions.explanation: At the end of three days after making the covenant, they heard that the people lived among them.

questions.text: Which of these was one of the Gibeonites' cities?
questions.explanation: Their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

questions.text: Why did the children of Israel not strike the Gibeonites?
questions.explanation: They did not strike them because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel.

answers.text: The princes had sworn to them by Yahweh
Joshua was away from the camp

questions.text: What did the Gibeonites become for the congregation?
questions.explanation: They became wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation, as the princes had said.

answers.text: Wood cutters and drawers of water
